name: Landon Dawson
strengths: Dawson works the intermediate middle with 6-3 length and reliable hands at the catch point.
Dawson shows enough athleticism after the catch to turn seams into chunk plays.
Dawson has a frame that can grow into in-line blocking without losing move-TE traits.
weaknesses: Dawson still needs to add mass to hold up every down as an in-line SEC blocker.
comparison: Dawson comps to Sam LaPorta — 6-3 move TE with reliable hands and enough athleticism to stress the middle of the field.
projection: Dawson projects as a Year 2 SEC starter at TE (package snaps Year 1). Ceiling: every-down SEC hybrid TE — the intermediate mismatch who can grow into complete in-line work.
schemeFit: Dawson fits a move / hybrid TE room that values intermediate reliability and seam YAC.
insiderNotes: Dawson is a 6-3 / 210 Mount Vernon tight end who wins in the intermediate middle with hands and enough YAC to punish light boxes. Wins with reliability and growing completeness — a Midwest TE mold for Florida’s hybrid room.
